title: Platinum Leonida
list_note: Official names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (cross-checked by Planet GTA 6, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are this entry's own words; every specific fact cites its source beside the guide. Methods the guides have not confirmed yet are marked unconfirmed, not invented.

roadmap.name: Story, in order
roadmap.note: Play the chapters in order. Story trophies pop as you finish each chapter and mission; nothing here can be missed. Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends.

roadmap.name: Stranger strands & activities
roadmap.note: Finish the stranger mission chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and the partner activities. Strands stay open once unlocked.

roadmap.name: Collectibles & counts
roadmap.note: Sweep Leonida for cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots and vehicles, and grind the counted activities: stunts, races, shooting range, challenges, robberies.

roadmap.name: Cleanup & 100%
roadmap.note: Mop up the last counts, money and exploration, then check the in-game 100% checklist for A Long Road. The platinum pops with it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_reason: It pops the moment the other 54 are earned, so there is nothing to miss.
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are done, so there is no separate task to it — it is the finish line of the roadmap below. Work the four phases in order and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_reason: It is the 100% checklist — nothing in it is missable as long as the one flagged trophy (Positive Mental Attitude) is handled in Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the gold that makes the platinum hard. The game tracks a 100% checklist (GTA Vice City Hub reports a 35-task checklist); the visible trophies already sketch what it covers: the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the counts in this guide. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours and calls this the hardest trophy, so treat it as the last thing you finish, in the cleanup phase. No exact 100% task list is published yet — check the in-game checklist as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_reason: No source lists this as missable. It can be done in free roam after the story; only Positive Mental Attitude is flagged as possibly missable (PowerPyx/GTABase).
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like, however the game counts each one. It is a grind, not a skill test: fold it into normal driving and the count climbs on its own, and the in-game counter shows how far along you are. No per-stunt list is published, so work from the counter and save the last stretch for the cleanup phase.
